subject.title: feat(webchat): reply-to a message with hydrated reply context

question: Should WebChat replies become a supported Gateway `chat.send.replyToId` contract that hydrates prior session content into the agent-facing reply-context envelope?
rationale: This is an additive, user-visible feature and public protocol extension; the PR body attributes the request to a maintainer, but the supplied discussion does not contain a durable maintainer decision on the exact protocol and prompt-context semantics.

options.title: Confirm the shared reply contract
options.body: Accept optional `replyToId` as the WebChat path to the existing reply-context envelope, subject to visible end-to-end proof.

options.title: Keep WebChat replies presentation-only
options.body: Retain the current inline-quote behavior and decline the new Gateway parameter if structured transcript hydration is not desired.

options.title: Narrow the API first
options.body: Specify a different WebChat-only or protocol-level reply representation before accepting the UI and Gateway changes.

recommendation.title: Confirm the shared reply contract
recommendation.body: Accept optional `replyToId` as the WebChat path to the existing reply-context envelope, subject to visible end-to-end proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged shared reply-context work is the closest concrete ownership signal for the envelope behavior this PR extends.
